cues: A population pyramid stacks age groups from young at the bottom to old at the top, males on the left, females on the right.
A broad base and a narrow top means many births and many deaths: rapid growth.
Near vertical sides mean slow growth.
And a base narrower than the middle means a population starting to shrink.
